results.title: Quality-preserving AI inference cost frontier
results.buyer: Enterprises and AI product operators with recurring, significant inference workloads
results.blocked_problem: A quality/latency/reliability-constrained AI workload is too costly to operate profitably or at its desired volume; current production configurations and fully optimized alternative runtimes may already meet the goal and must be checked.
results.deliverable: Deployable and reversible serving configuration, runtime adaptation or optimization artifact, with representative benchmark receipts, independent quality verification, workload-level cost accounting and incident rollback.
results.acceptance_test: Blind held-out request-quality parity and approved model/configuration constraints; fixed-volume and representative traffic; independently measured p95/p99 latency, actual $ per accepted request, reliability, utilization, capacity and rollback; compares tuned vLLM/TensorRT-LLM, capable specialist, buy/partner and no change with matching permissions and complete lifecycle costs.
results.strongest_complete_alternative: Competently tuned vLLM or TensorRT-LLM, cloud managed inference optimizer, qualified human+AI serving team, specialist performance consultancy and no change.
results.first_discriminating_test: Freeze one permissioned or open inference workload, quality/latency contract, production-equivalent traffic and billable cost method; run independent matched tests against best tuned incumbent, isolate accepted cost/capacity benefit, test two deliberate quality/latency failure mutants, and identify a previously blocked workload now within an actual budget (if any).
results.note: First ENGINE Ω commercial wedge hypothesis; a vendor demo or model release does not establish five-week novel optimization. Pilot price is an illustrative untested offer hypothesis. The cost-per-accepted threshold in this catalog is a coarse planning gate, not a measured deployment metric; the acceptance contract must use application-level $/accepted-request and actual cash savings or additional usable capacity. No customer, permission, benchmark result or paid outcome is represented.
